Create a single game tile sheet image for an isometric 2D game. Theme: Minoan sci-fi
WAREHOUSE / cargo depot architecture — cream limestone block masonry, slate-grey and
navy-blue industrial stone, red-plastered fresco panels (charging bull with lilies, red
running-spiral / wave friezes), red tapering Minoan columns with black capitals and gold
bands, gold/bronze trim, yellow-and-black hazard stripes, deep blue tech panels with glowing
cyan light strips, gold horns of consecration. Painted, detailed, clean hard edges,
consistent style and colour palette across all pieces. Same art style as a Minoan palace
tile sheet: this is its industrial companion set.

=== CANVAS (exact) ===
- Image size: exactly 2048 x 1920 pixels.
- Background: one flat solid colour, pure magenta #FF00FF, everywhere that is not a piece.
  No gradient, no texture, no vignette, no grid lines, no borders, no frames, no panels,
  no labels, no text, no title, no numbers, no drop shadows on the background.
  NOT an exploded view, NOT an assembled building, NOT a presentation board: only the
  individual pieces, one per cell.
- Grid: 8 columns x 6 rows of invisible cells, each cell exactly 256 x 320 pixels
  (cell x = col*256, cell y = row*320). Exactly ONE piece per cell, never crossing its cell.

=== PROJECTION (exact, no perspective) ===
- True 2:1 isometric (dimetric) projection: every receding edge rises exactly 1 pixel
  vertically per 2 pixels horizontally (angle 26.565°). Vertical edges stay perfectly
  vertical. NO perspective, NO vanishing points, NO camera tilt, NO fisheye — parallel lines
  stay parallel. Every piece in the sheet uses this same projection and the same scale.
- Light comes from the upper-left for every piece. Faces turned to the left/front-left are
  lit; faces turned to the right are about 20% darker.

=== PIECE GEOMETRY (exact, in pixels, relative to each cell's top-left corner) ===
FLOOR / ROOF TILE = a flat diamond, 256 wide x 128 tall, corners at
  top (128,176), right (256,240), bottom (128,304), left (0,240).
  Flat top surface only: NO slab thickness, NO visible side faces, NO bevelled rim.
  It must tile seamlessly with copies of itself edge to edge (patterns continue across
  edges). Roof equipment (vents, solar panels, hatches) is painted flat on the surface.

WALL "LEFT" (wall running down-right, facing the viewer's left) = a parallelogram,
  corners (64,8) -> (192,72) -> (192,312) -> (64,248).
  i.e. 128 px wide, 240 px tall, top and bottom edges slope DOWN to the right at 2:1.

WALL "RIGHT" (wall running up-right, facing the viewer's right) = a parallelogram,
  corners (64,72) -> (192,8) -> (192,248) -> (64,312).
  i.e. top and bottom edges slope UP to the right at 2:1.
  IMPORTANT: walls are TALL — 240 px tall for 128 px wide (almost twice as tall as wide).
  Draw only the flat front face filling the parallelogram completely: NO top thickness,
  NO cap block on top, NO side/end faces, NO depth. Left and right ends must tile
  seamlessly with the next wall segment (stone courses, friezes and trim continue across
  the joint). Every wall has the same base: a dark slate stone dado along the bottom 12%
  (with a thin cyan light strip), and a cream cornice band along the top 6%.

DOORWAY WALLS: same parallelogram, but the door opening is fully transparent (pure magenta)
  from 27% to 73% of the wall's width and from 36% of its height down to the bottom,
  framed by a bronze/steel door frame with yellow-black hazard stripes on the jambs.
  Nothing (no door leaves, no shutter) inside the opening — it must be empty magenta.

STANDING OBJECTS (columns, props, decor): stand upright, centred horizontally in the cell,
  base touching y = 304 at x = 128, never wider than 220 px or taller than 300 px.
  Include only a small soft contact shadow directly under the object, nothing else.

=== CELL CONTENTS (row by row, columns 0..7) ===
Row 0 — FLOOR TILES (diamond): 0 slate-grey stone paving, 1 slate paving variant (worn,
  scuffed), 2 large cream limestone slabs, 3 loading-bay floor with yellow-black hazard
  border and white chevron arrows, 4 steel floor grating over a dark pit with cyan glow,
  5 navy tech floor panel with glowing cyan edge strips, 6 cream and slate checker
  paving, 7 oil-stained industrial concrete.
Row 1 — WALLS facing LEFT (parallelogram "LEFT"): 0 plain cream ashlar blocks,
  1 slate-grey industrial blocks with a cyan light strip, 2 red plaster panel with a
  charging-bull fresco and lilies, 3 red running-spiral / wave frieze band across cream
  stone, 4 cream stone with a vertical glowing blue tech slot, 5 tech window (dark glass,
  gold frame, cyan glow), 6 DOORWAY (person-sized, see DOORWAY WALLS),
  7 cream stone with a closed cargo shutter painted flat (grey roll-up door, hazard stripes).
Row 2 — WALLS facing RIGHT (parallelogram "RIGHT"): the same eight designs as row 1,
  in the same order, drawn for this orientation and lighting (re-drawn, not mirrored, so
  frescoes still read correctly).
Row 3 — ROOF TILES (diamond): 0 flat cream roof terrace, 1 navy tech roof slab with
  inset panels, 2 roof with solar panel array, 3 roof with steel vent grilles,
  4 roof hatch with cyan-lit rim, 5 roof with skylight (blue glass), 6 gold-trimmed cream
  roof, 7 plain slate roof.
Row 4 — ARCHITECTURAL PIECES (standing objects): 0 red Minoan column (tapering downward,
  black round capital, gold bands) exactly 272 px tall, 1 square cream stone pillar
  272 px tall, 2 gold horns of consecration on a small red-and-cream plinth,
  3 twin antenna mast with blue tips, 4 roof corner cap block (cream with blue tech inset),
  5 small roof tech unit (cream box with glowing cyan vent), 6 yellow cargo crane on a
  steel frame holding a hanging crate, 7 red banner with a double axe (labrys) on a pole.
Row 5 — PROPS (standing objects): 0 steel cargo crate with gold corners, 1 stack of two
  steel crates, 2 tech cargo container with glowing blue panel, 3 wooden-and-bronze supply
  crates stack, 4 painted red pithos jar with spiral motif, 5 yellow cargo forklift /
  loader, 6 steel storage shelving rack with crates, 7 small cyan-glowing power cell canister.

=== RULES ===
- Keep every piece inside its cell; leave at least 4 px of magenta around each piece.
- Use the exact sizes above so all pieces share one scale: a wall is exactly one storey
  (240 px tall), a floor/roof tile is exactly 256 x 128.
- Do not use magenta (#FF00FF) or near-magenta / pink colours anywhere in the artwork.
- No text, no labels, no captions, no watermark anywhere on the image.
